params.prompt: Precise photo-in interior image EDIT for Mineral & Walnut Option 1 refinement. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and dictates the exact camera, crop and accepted room layout. Image 2 is the real MODEL-HOME structural reference only: preserve its existing architecture without reverting the selected furniture or camera. Image 3 is a MATERIAL SWATCH only for owners brown oak/polished stainless, NOT a cabinet silhouette to copy. Create warm, sophisticated, lived-in modern luxury on a realistic build budget. Keep original room dimensions, openings, ceiling/crown and streetscape. Respect rich walnut accents while integrating selected smoky BROWN OAK casegoods; do NOT turn every wood surface grey. Ivory upholstery, natural pale oak floor, softly warm mineral walls, restrained charcoal, living greenery and selective polished silver; no brass/gold, no blue/yellow repeated theme. Different furniture silhouettes but shared restrained palette. Quiet plaster movement; natural daylight with believable soft shadows, no sepia filter, no exaggerated CGI shine, no orange LED strips. No people, new windows, new arches, relocated doors, added ceilings, text, labels or collage. This is one single photorealistic room image, same frame as image 1. Keep the TV above the fireplace and both high transoms, terrace glazing, crown and ceiling. Refine the living group with a generously comfortable WHITE Cloud-style sofa in its current footprint and two softly curved ivory chairs. A broad rounded pale limestone-look coffee table makes a useful reachable landing instead of more walnut; add one small polished-stainless drink table beside an armchair without blocking passage. Beneath EACH high window retain a low console with sibling artworks above: related ivory/charcoal abstractions, with only a trace of muted smoky blue in one work and ONE small muted blue-grey pillow; neither blue nor yellow leads. Consoles should be brown-oak, varied door-front construction, subtle polished stainless handles, continuous plinth bases WITHOUT feet, adapting owners materials rather than copying the screenshot. Keep warm walnut limited to a supporting piece if visible. A single tall leafy plant, one warm shaded lamp, and generous empty surfaces; no decorative clutter. Keep sideboard tops practical. Pale natural oak flooring as target image; large low-pile oatmeal rug under the whole seating grouping. Layer fine ivory sheer curtains with ivory side panels, preserving open glass and access.

qa.note: Visible transoms, fireplace/chase, terrace glazing and flat crown ceiling compared with the original photo. GR2 is a closer derived finish view, not a surveyed camera. TV-above-fireplace location retained by owner direction; confirm appliance heat clearances.

params.prompt: Precisely edit only WALL FINISH, LED INTENSITY and WINDOW SHEERS in this existing bedroom render. Keep every furniture shape, placement, wood material, camera, TV, soundbar, 4-sash window, doors, ceiling, floor, rug and art unchanged. IMPORTANT the mottled wall above the bed is too busy: make it a subtly hand-finished very smooth warm ivory limestone shade, almost uniform with very faint movement, no dramatic trowel marks anywhere. Reduce headboard and underbed/under-nightstand LED intensity by about 85 percent: a barely visible warm-neutral 2700K glow, absolutely no bright orange/yellow band and no orange pools on floor. Keep individual reading sconces. Add fine transparent ivory sheers across the four-sash window group, visible sashes behind, plus full-height ivory blackout drapery stacked at both sides, open for daylight. Keep white upholstered platform, floating WALNUT bedside drawers, brown oak and subtle steel floor-standing dressers with continuous bases, blue-gray folded throw and green plant. Photorealistic soft daylight without color tint, no other edits.

qa.note: Bed remains on the right wall, four-sash window group and the opposite TV/soundbar retained. Decorative LEDs are dimmed for the daylight scene; night scene output and control are still to specify. Paired views are illustrative: select one dresser design, measured curtain system and exact wood finish before purchasing.
